name: Layered maps
summary: One gas at a time, from NASA's GEOS-CF model. Higher values play higher notes in that gas's own instrument; hover, touch or use the arrow keys.
author: moran
description: Pick one gas with the Dataset menu (ozone, carbon monoxide or nitrogen oxides): the map shows that gas and you hear only it, in its own instrument and pitch range (carbon monoxide low, ozone in the middle, nitrogen oxides higher). Higher values play higher notes. Hover, touch or use the arrow keys.
